reason: Credit support to AI cloud partners is a programme within q09's financing-and-backstop total, but this question measures the amount at the 2027-12-31 check date, not at the FY2027 year-end, so the amounts can differ (MATCHING-v2 §1 limit, as with dev-d1 clean-1).
Vera Rubin is the Rubin generation, and the same first shipment by 2026-12-31 settles both.

Beijing permitting H200 sales into China is the same Chinese authorization that lets Chinese companies import H200s (R2-f). The deadline is effectively the same, late January 2027 against January 31, 2027.

Its outcome and period rest only on the big four's combined calendar-2026 data-center capex. The ~$1 trillion figure for 2027 is a benchmark to compare against, not a separate check, so the same 2026 figure settles both.
First shipment of the Kyber NVL144 rack with Rubin Ultra by 2027-12-31 settles both. A slip to 2028 is q18's no.
NVIDIA's supply purchase commitments to its suppliers are a different reported figure from q09's financing commitments and backstops to customers and partners, and from q12's capital spending.

The big four's calendar-2026 spending on custom AI accelerators is the core part of cloud providers' calendar-2026 custom-silicon total, and a part of a reference total does not separate them (boundary 1).

The share of Chinese AI-accelerator budgets going to domestic suppliers over the 12 months to mid-2027 is a different figure and period from NVIDIA's share of China's calendar-2026 spending, so the two answers can move apart.
No reference question covers the French competition authority's antitrust decision on NVIDIA.

It bundles new HBM capacity coming online, a check of its own that can resolve independently, with whether memory prices stay at record highs through late 2027. q05 is a different figure: the percent change in 2027 versus 2026 DRAM/HBM contract prices.
